item.title: Unidentified person fires outside Bollywood director Rohit Shetty’s residence in Mumbai’s Juhu
item.description: Unidentified persons allegedly fired four rounds outside Bollywood director Rohit Shetty’s residence in Mumbai’s Juhu area around 12.43 am, triggering heightened security, police said on Sunday. item.title: Union Budget 2026 LIVE Updates: New Income Tax Act to come into effect from April 1, 2026
item.description: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman is all set to present the Union Budget 2026–27 in Parliament today, marking a record ninth consecutive budget of her tenure. The budget speech will start at 11 a.m. in the Lok Sabha as part of the ongoing Budget Session. This is the first time an Indian finance minister will be delivering nine back-to-back Union Budgets, underlining continuity in the government’s economic leadership since 2019.
